meta.reps_note: PATCH 6: mde_search now runs the FULL requested replicate count for every candidate-effect cell. The previous max(500, reps//4) reduction is removed, so the documented and actual counts are identical.
meta.effect_ray_note: mde_search moves detection gain and warning gain TOGETHER at +1 pp : +0.1 day. Its output is a MINIMUM DETECTABLE JOINT EFFECT ALONG THIS RAY, never a one-dimensional MDE, and must be reported with the ray stated. The 2-D surface is the preferred object.
meta.p_B_source: preregistered sweep; no result-derived input used
meta.endpoint: pre-symptomatic = first qualifying alert in [onset-21, onset-1]; warning >= 1 day by construction; same-day alerts are NOT pre-symptomatic
meta.precision_note: paired warning-time CI is computed on the detected-under-both subgroup with no zero-imputation
meta.dependence_note: cross-schedule dependence is NOT identifiable from the S1 arm; it is swept over this preregistered grid
meta.test: exact binomial sign test on hierarchical win/loss
